items.text: Updated my Week 5 Fantasy Rankings with Buccaneers-Cowboys inactives and the latest injury news. Keeping an eye on the long list of injured stars trying to get back on the field this week, including whether Ja'Marr Chase can clear concussion protocol before Sunday.
items.why: Still working through concussion protocol; limited Thursday.
items.implication: Game-time or OUT risk vs MIA; Tee Higgins also dinged.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Gesicki/other Bengals pass catchers rise.

items.text: Eagles say DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again today.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hamstring injuries; week-to-week, not long-term per reports.
items.implication: Unlikely to play Week 5 vs JAX in London; monitor Friday but expect OUT.
items.opportunity: Backfield and WR targets open with Bigsby also out/IR.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson did not practice today due to his ankle injury. Friday’s practice, whether or not Jackson goes, looms large as it relates to his potential availability for Sunday night’s game in Atlanta.
items.why: Ankle sprain from Week 4; consecutive DNPs make Friday critical.
items.implication: Outside chance or multi-game miss; Huntley likely if OUT.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass catchers and RBs see script change if Huntley starts.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice today due to his shoulder injury.
items.why: Shoulder injury; first full DNP noted this week.
items.opportunity: Other Bills WRs see target bump if limited/OUT.

items.text: No practice again today for WR Ladd McConkey.
items.implication: Questionable to OUT risk vs DEN; low chance if no Friday practice.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston and other Chargers WRs elevated routes/targets.

items.text: Love, love, LOVE Nico Collins against the Titans this week. I have Nico as my WR8.
items.why: Volume including red zone vs Titans defense struggles vs WRs.
items.implication: Strong WR1/WR2 start; high ranking confidence.
items.opportunity: Target hog and RZ usage in favorable matchup.

items.text: For a second straight day, Bears RB Kyle Monangai didn’t practice due to thumb and toe injuries. Bears RB D’Andre Swift practiced on a limited basis due to knee and hip injuries.
items.why: Swift limited knee/hip; Monangai DNP thumb/turf toe.
items.implication: Swift more likely to play but monitored; Monangai doubtful.
items.opportunity: If Monangai out, Swift lead role solidifies.

items.text: Bad news: #Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr aggravated his foot injury and coach Mike McCarthy said he'll miss multiple weeks. Pittman had been dealing with plantar fasciitis.
items.why: Re-aggravated plantar fasciitis; coach confirmation of multi-week absence.
items.implication: Out Week 5 and beyond; Steelers WR depth thins.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf and others absorb targets.

items.text: “I think it’s gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville” @adamlevitan and @evansilva talk Philly’s RB room following the Barkley/Bigsby injuries.
items.why: Barkley and Bigsby both out; Shipley expected to lead touches vs JAX.
items.implication: Shipley becomes viable RB flex/RB3 with volume opportunity in London game.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/routes in depleted PHI backfield.

items.text: Michael Wilson vs. DET (WR10) among pass catchers Berry loves for Week 5 due to volume and matchup.
items.why: Seeing volume including red zone; DET struggles against receivers.

items.text: Chase Brown @ MIA (RB5) among RBs Berry loves; tied to defenses getting carved by RBs and workload, plus Bengals WR injuries.
items.why: Workload + soft matchup; potential more passing game involvement if Chase/Higgins limited.
items.opportunity: Carries + possible route increase from teammate absences.

items.text: Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) among pass catchers Berry hates; tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
items.why: Tough matchup, usage numbers, hamstring wrinkle.

items.text: Last week was tough, but I’m keeping it open on Bucky Irving as my RB15 for Week 5.
items.why: Prior tough week but maintaining RB15 ranking; later big TNF run noted.

items.text: Bijan Robinson, Kyren Williams performing well above expected on their opportunities so far. Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming on theirs. Reminder that in-season subscribers can always see our sortable xFP data here.
items.why: xFP overperformance for Bijan/Kyren; under for Jeanty/Chase Brown on opportunities.
items.implication: Sustain or regression watch; Bijan/Kyren more trustworthy volume converters currently.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown RB5 despite under xFP.
